AI.tldr: 本文发现，在机器学习流水线生成任务中，大语言模型在特征选择阶段存在严重偏见（敏感属性出现率87.7%），远高于传统简单条件语句评估得出的59.2%，表明现有基准测试严重低估了实际部署中的偏见风险。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成偏见评估主要通过简单条件语句进行，这仅代表了真实编程场景的极小部分，且只能发现显性的、明确编码的偏见。作者认为这种方法严重低估了实际中的偏见问题，因此提出了更贴近现实的评估任务——生成机器学习流水线。
AI.method: 使用代码专用和通用大语言模型生成完整的机器学习流水线，重点分析特征选择阶段是否包含敏感属性，并与传统条件语句生成的偏见率进行对比。同时测试了不同提示缓解策略、不同属性数量及不同流水线难度下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在机器学习流水线中，敏感属性平均出现率为87.7%，远高于条件语句的59.2%。模型能够合理排除无关特征（如保留"种族"但丢弃"最喜欢的颜色"），说明并非随机行为。这些发现在多种条件下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 简单条件语句不能作为代码生成偏见的有效评估代理，当前基准测试严重低估了实际部署中的偏见风险，需要更真实的评估任务来衡量模型偏见。

title: Gmd: Gaussian mixture descriptor for pair matching of 3D fragments
comment: 24 pages, 10 figures. Published in Multimedia Systems
summary: In the automatic reassembly of fragments acquired using laser scanners to reconstruct objects, a crucial step is the matching of fractured surfaces. In this paper, we propose a novel local descriptor that uses the Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) to fit the distribution of points, allowing for the description and matching of fractured surfaces of fragments. Our method involves dividing a local surface patch into concave and convex regions for estimating the k value of GMM. Then the final Gaussian Mixture Descriptor (GMD) of the fractured surface is formed by merging the regional GMDs. To measure the similarities between GMDs for determining adjacent fragments, we employ the L2 distance and align the fragments using Random Sample Consensus (RANSAC) and Iterative Closest Point (ICP). The extensive experiments on real-scanned public datasets and Terracotta datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach; furthermore, the comparisons with several existing methods also validate the advantage of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于高斯混合模型（GMM）的新型局部描述子（GMD），用于碎片断裂面的匹配与自动重组，在真实扫描数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 激光扫描碎片自动重组中，断裂面匹配是关键步骤，现有方法在该任务上精度不足。
AI.method: 将局部曲面片分为凹凸区域以估计GMM的k值，合并区域GMD形成最终描述子，采用L2距离度量相似度，结合RANSAC和ICP进行对齐。
AI.result: 在真实扫描公共数据集和兵马俑数据集上取得良好效果，优于多种现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提GMD描述子在碎片断裂面匹配与重组任务中有效且具有优势。

title: Beyond N-gram: Data-Aware X-GRAM Extraction for Efficient Embedding Parameter Scaling
summary: Large token-indexed lookup tables provide a compute-decoupled scaling path, but their practical gains are often limited by poor parameter efficiency and rapid memory growth. We attribute these limitations to Zipfian under-training of the long tail, heterogeneous demand across layers, and "slot collapse" that produces redundant embeddings. To address this, we propose X-GRAM, a frequency-aware dynamic token-injection framework. X-GRAM employs hybrid hashing and alias mixing to compress the tail while preserving head capacity, and refines retrieved vectors via normalized SwiGLU ShortConv to extract diverse local n-gram features. These signals are integrated into attention value streams and inter-layer residuals using depth-aware gating, effectively aligning static memory with dynamic context. This design introduces a memory-centric scaling axis that decouples model capacity from FLOPs. Extensive evaluations at the 0.73B and 1.15B scales show that X-GRAM improves average accuracy by as much as 4.4 points over the vanilla backbone and 3.2 points over strong retrieval baselines, while using substantially smaller tables in the 50% configuration. Overall, by decoupling capacity from compute through efficient memory management, X-GRAM offers a scalable and practical paradigm for future memory-augmented architectures. Code aviliable in https://github.com/Longyichen/X-gram.

AI.tldr: X-GRAM 提出了一种频率感知的动态令牌注入框架，通过混合哈希、别名混合、深度感知门控等技术，有效解决了大规模令牌索引查找表中长尾欠训练、层间需求异质和槽坍塌等问题，在0.73B和1.15B规模下平均准确率提升最高达4.4个点，同时使用更小的查找表，实现容量与计算解耦。
AI.motivation: 大规模令牌索引查找表虽然在计算-容量解耦路径上有潜力，但存在参数效率低、内存增长快的问题。作者将这些问题归因于长尾分布的Zipfian欠训练、不同层对记忆需求的异质性，以及导致冗余嵌入的"槽坍塌"现象。
AI.method: X-GRAM 包含三个关键技术：1）混合哈希与别名混合（hybrid hashing and alias mixing），压缩长尾同时保留头部容量；2）归一化SwiGLU ShortConv对检索到的向量进行精炼，提取多样化的局部n-gram特征；3）深度感知门控（depth-aware gating），将这些信号集成到注意力值流和层间残差中，对齐静态内存与动态上下文。
AI.result: 在0.73B和1.15B参数规模下，X-GRAM相对于原始骨干网络平均准确率提升最高4.4个点，相对于强检索基线提升3.2个点，且在50%配置下使用了更小的查找表。
AI.conclusion: X-GRAM通过高效的内存管理实现了容量与计算的解耦，为未来的记忆增强架构提供了一种可扩展且实用的范式。

title: Bridging the Training-Deployment Gap: Gated Encoding and Multi-Scale Refinement for Efficient Quantization-Aware Image Enhancement
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the Mobile AI (MAI) 2026 Workshop at CVPR 2026
summary: Image enhancement models for mobile devices often struggle to balance high output quality with the fast processing speeds required by mobile hardware. While recent deep learning models can enhance low-quality mobile photos into high-quality images, their performance is often degraded when converted to lower-precision formats for actual use on mobile phones. To address this training-deployment mismatch, we propose an efficient image enhancement model designed specifically for mobile deployment. Our approach uses a hierarchical network architecture with gated encoder blocks and multiscale refinement to preserve fine-grained visual features. Moreover, we incorporate Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) to simulate the effects of low-precision representation during the training process. This allows the network to adapt and prevents the typical drop in quality seen with standard post-training quantization (PTQ). Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method produces high-fidelity visual output while maintaining the low computational overhead needed for practical use on standard mobile devices. The code will be available at https://github.com/GenAI4E/QATIE.git.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对移动设备部署的图像增强模型，采用分层网络架构和量化感知训练（QAT），在保持高质量输出的同时降低计算开销，解决了训练与部署之间的精度不匹配问题。
AI.motivation: 移动设备上的图像增强模型在训练时使用高精度格式，但部署到手机上需转换为低精度格式，导致性能下降。为消除这种训练-部署不匹配，需要设计专门针对移动端部署的高效模型。
AI.method: 采用分层网络架构，包含门控编码器块和多尺度精炼模块以保留细粒度视觉特征；同时引入量化感知训练（QAT），在训练过程中模拟低精度表示的效果，使网络适应部署时的精度限制。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法能生成高保真视觉输出，同时保持低计算开销，适合在标准移动设备上实际使用，避免了标准后训练量化（PTQ）常见的质量下降问题。
AI.conclusion: 提出的量化感知图像增强模型（QATIE）有效解决了移动端部署中的精度不匹配问题，在输出质量和计算效率之间取得了良好平衡，代码已开源。

title: Seeing Isn't Believing: Uncovering Blind Spots in Evaluator Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate outputs of other models, for image-to-text (I2T) tasks such as visual question answering, and text-to-image (T2I) generation tasks. Despite this growing reliance, the reliability of these Evaluator VLMs remains under explored. In this work, we systematically evaluate the reliability of Evaluator VLMs across both I2T and T2I tasks. We introduce targeted perturbations that degrade output quality along key error dimensions, including object hallucinations, spatial reasoning, factual grounding, and visual fidelity. These perturbations test whether Evaluator VLMs can reliably account for these quality degrading errors in their evaluations. Using a comprehensive benchmark of over 4000 perturbed instances spanning 40 perturbation dimensions, we evaluate 4 prominent VLMs using single-answer scoring, pairwise comparison, and reference-guided paradigms. Our findings reveal that current VLM evaluators exhibit substantial blind spots: they often fail to detect perturbed outputs - in some cases exceeding 50%, struggle particularly with fine-grained compositional and spatial errors, and are often insensitive to hallucinated content that contradicts the input image. Pairwise comparison proves more reliable, though failure rates persist. These results highlight the unreliable nature of current Evaluator VLMs and urge caution in their deployment for benchmarking and development decisions. Code and data have been made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了当前大型视觉-语言模型(VLM)作为评估器的可靠性，发现其在检测对象幻觉、空间推理、事实基础等错误时存在显著盲区，失败率超过50%，尤其对细粒度组合和空间错误敏感度低，提示需谨慎使用VLM进行模型评估。
AI.motivation: 尽管VLMs被广泛用于评估其他模型的输出（包括图像到文本和文本到图像任务），但其作为评估器本身的可靠性尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 引入针对关键错误维度的定向扰动（如对象幻觉、空间推理、事实基础、视觉保真度），构建包含4000+扰动实例（覆盖40个扰动维度）的基准，使用4种主流VLM在单答案评分、成对比较和参考引导三种评估范式下进行测试。
AI.result: 当前VLM评估器存在严重盲点：检测扰动输出的失败率有时超过50%，尤其难以识别细粒度组合和空间错误，对与输入图像矛盾的幻觉内容也不敏感；成对比较范式相对更可靠，但失败率仍然存在。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM评估器不够可靠，在用于基准测试和模型开发决策时应保持谨慎。

title: AEL: Agent Evolving Learning for Open-Ended Environments
summary: LLM agents increasingly operate in open-ended environments spanning hundreds of sequential episodes, yet they remain largely stateless: each task is solved from scratch without converting past experience into better future behavior. The central obstacle is not \emph{what} to remember but \emph{how to use} what has been remembered, including which retrieval policy to apply, how to interpret prior outcomes, and when the current strategy itself must change. We introduce \emph{Agent Evolving Learning} (\ael{}), a two-timescale framework that addresses this obstacle. At the fast timescale, a Thompson Sampling bandit learns which memory retrieval policy to apply at each episode; at the slow timescale, LLM-driven reflection diagnoses failure patterns and injects causal insights into the agent's decision prompt, giving it an interpretive frame for the evidence it retrieves. On a sequential portfolio benchmark (10 sector-diverse tickers, 208 episodes, 5 random seeds), \ael{} achieves a Sharpe ratio of 2.13$\pm$0.47, outperforming five published self-improving methods and all non-LLM baselines while maintaining the lowest variance among all LLM-based approaches. A nine-variant ablation reveals a ``less is more'' pattern: memory and reflection together produce a 58\% cumulative improvement over the stateless baseline, yet every additional mechanism we test (planner evolution, per-tool selection, cold-start initialization, skill extraction, and three credit assignment methods) \emph{degrades} performance. This demonstrates that the bottleneck in agent self-improvement is \emph{self-diagnosing how to use} experience rather than adding architectural complexity. Code and data: https://github.com/WujiangXu/AEL.

AI.tldr: 提出Agent进化学习（AEL）框架，通过双时间尺度机制（快速：Thompson Sampling选择检索策略；慢速：LLM驱动反思注入因果洞察）解决LLM智能体跨回合经验利用问题，在组合基准上实现最优夏普比率2.13±0.47，消融实验揭示“少即是多”规律。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在开放环境执行数百个序列回合时仍是“无状态”的——每个任务从零开始，无法将过往经验转化为未来行为的改进。核心障碍不在于记住什么，而在于如何利用已记住的内容，包括选择何种检索策略、如何解释历史结果，以及何时自身策略需要改变。
AI.method: 提出AEL双时间尺度框架：（1）快时间尺度：Thompson Sampling赌博机为每个回合学习选择最优记忆检索策略；（2）慢时间尺度：LLM驱动的反思模块诊断失败模式，将因果洞察注入智能体的决策提示，为检索到的证据提供解释框架。
AI.result: 在包含10个行业多样化股票、208个回合、5个随机种子的序列组合基准上，AEL的夏普比率为2.13±0.47，超越5种自改进方法和所有非LLM基线，且在所有LLM方法中方差最低。九种变体消融实验显示：记忆与反思结合带来58%的累积提升，但每种额外机制（规划器进化、工具选择、冷启动初始化、技能提取、三种信用分配方法）都降低性能。
AI.conclusion: 智能体自改进的瓶颈在于自我诊断如何使用经验，而非增加架构复杂性——即“少即是多”。

title: Thinking with Reasoning Skills: Fewer Tokens, More Accuracy
comment: 10 pages, The 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics -- Industry Track
summary: Reasoning LLMs often spend substantial tokens on long intermediate reasoning traces (e.g., chain-of-thought) when solving new problems. We propose to summarize and store reusable reasoning skills distilled from extensive deliberation and trial-and-error exploration, and to retrieve these skills at inference time to guide future reasoning. Unlike the prevailing \emph{reasoning from scratch} paradigm, our approach first recalls relevant skills for each query, helping the model avoid redundant detours and focus on effective solution paths. We evaluate our method on coding and mathematical reasoning tasks, and find that it significantly reduces reasoning tokens while improving overall performance. The resulting lower per-request cost indicates strong practical and economic potential for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出通过总结和存储可复用的推理技能，在推理时检索这些技能来指导模型，减少冗余推理token并提升性能。
AI.motivation: 推理大模型在解决新问题时往往需要大量中间推理步骤（如思维链），消耗大量token，效率低下。
AI.method: 将深思熟虑和试错探索中提炼的推理技能进行总结与存储，在推理时检索相关技能来引导模型，替代从零推理的范式。
AI.result: 在编程和数学推理任务上显著减少了推理token数量，同时提升了整体性能，降低了每次请求的成本。
AI.conclusion: 该技能检索方法在降低推理成本的同时提升性能，具有实际部署的强经济和实用潜力。

title: Attention-based multiple instance learning for predominant growth pattern prediction in lung adenocarcinoma wsi using foundation models
summary: Lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) grading depends on accurately identifying growth patterns, which are indicators of prognosis and can influence treatment decisions. Common deep learning approaches to determine the predominant pattern rely on patch-level classification or segmentation, requiring extensive annotations. This study proposes an attention-based multiple instance learning (ABMIL) framework to predict the predominant LUAD growth pattern at the whole slide level to reduce annotation burden. Our approach integrates pretrained pathology foundation models as patch encoders, used either frozen or fine-tuned on annotated patches, to extract discriminative features that are aggregated through attention mechanisms. Experiments show that fine-tuned encoders improve performance, with Prov-GigaPath achieving the highest agreement (\k{appa} = 0.699) under ABMIL. Compared to simple patch-aggregation baselines, ABMIL yields more robust predictions by leveraging slide-level supervision and spatial attention. Future work will extend this framework to estimate the full distribution of growth patterns and validate performance on external cohorts.

AI.tldr: 提出基于注意力机制的多实例学习框架，利用预训练的病理学基础模型作为编码器，在全切片级别预测肺腺癌主要生长模式，减少标注负担，实验显示微调编码器结合ABMIL取得了最高的一致性（κ=0.699）。
AI.motivation: 肺腺癌分级依赖于准确识别生长模式，但传统的深度学习方法需要大量细粒度标注（如补丁级分类或分割），标注成本高昂。本研究旨在通过弱监督学习降低标注负担。
AI.method: 采用注意力机制的多实例学习（ABMIL）框架，使用预训练的病理学基础模型（如Prov-GigaPath）作为补丁编码器，可选择冻结或微调编码器，通过注意力机制聚合补丁特征，在全切片级别进行预测。
AI.result: 微调编码器相比冻结编码器性能更优，其中Prov-GigaPath在ABMIL框架下取得了最高的一致性（κ=0.699），且ABMIL比简单的补丁聚合基线方法更鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: ABMIL框架能有效预测肺腺癌主要生长模式，未来工作将扩展至估计生长模式的完整分布，并在外部数据集上验证性能。

title: StructMem: Structured Memory for Long-Horizon Behavior in LLMs
summary: Long-term conversational agents need memory systems that capture relationships between events, not merely isolated facts, to support temporal reasoning and multi-hop question answering. Current approaches face a fundamental trade-off: flat memory is efficient but fails to model relational structure, while graph-based memory enables structured reasoning at the cost of expensive and fragile construction. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{StructMem}, a structure-enriched hierarchical memory framework that preserves event-level bindings and induces cross-event connections. By temporally anchoring dual perspectives and performing periodic semantic consolidation, StructMem improves temporal reasoning and multi-hop performance on \texttt{LoCoMo}, while substantially reducing token usage, API calls, and runtime compared to prior memory systems, see https://github.com/zjunlp/LightMem .

AI.tldr: StructMem是一种结构增强的分层记忆框架，通过保留事件级绑定和诱导跨事件连接，在降低资源消耗的同时提升了长程对话的时间推理和多跳问答能力。
AI.motivation: 现有对话记忆系统面临两难：平面记忆效率高但缺乏关系结构，图记忆支持结构化推理但构建昂贵且脆弱。
AI.method: 提出StructMem框架，采用双视角时间锚定和周期性语义整合，构建结构增强的分层记忆，同时保留事件级绑定并生成跨事件连接。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo数据集上，StructMem提升了时间推理和多跳问答性能，同时大幅减少了token用量、API调用次数和运行时间。
AI.conclusion: StructMem有效平衡了记忆的结构化表达与资源效率，为长程对话系统提供了一种更实用的记忆解决方案。

title: Who Defines "Best"? Towards Interactive, User-Defined Evaluation of LLM Leaderboards
comment: Accepted to the 2026 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT 2026)
summary: LLM leaderboards are widely used to compare models and guide deployment decisions. However, leaderboard rankings are shaped by evaluation priorities set by benchmark designers, rather than by the diverse goals and constraints of actual users and organizations. A single aggregate score often obscures how models behave across different prompt types and compositions. In this work, we conduct an in-depth analysis of the dataset used in the LMArena (formerly Chatbot Arena) benchmark and investigate this evaluation challenge by designing an interactive visualization interface as a design probe. Our analysis reveals that the dataset is heavily skewed toward certain topics, that model rankings vary across prompt slices, and that preference-based judgments are used in ways that blur their intended scope. Building on this analysis, we introduce a visualization interface that allows users to define their own evaluation priorities by selecting and weighting prompt slices and to explore how rankings change accordingly. A qualitative study suggests that this interactive approach improves transparency and supports more context-specific model evaluation, pointing toward alternative ways to design and use LLM leaderboards.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了LMArena基准测试数据集，发现其存在主题偏差、模型排名随提示切片变化、偏好判断使用模糊等问题，并设计了一个交互式可视化界面，让用户自定义评估优先级来重新排名，通过定性研究证明了该方法能提升透明度和支持更情境化的模型评估。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM排行榜由基准设计者的评估优先级决定，忽略了实际用户和组织的多样化目标与约束；单一的聚合分数掩盖了模型在不同提示类型和组合下的表现差异。
AI.method: 对LMArena数据集进行深度分析（主题偏差、提示切片排名变化、偏好判断使用问题），并设计交互式可视化界面作为设计探针，允许用户选择和加权提示切片来定义自己的评估优先级。
AI.result: 数据集严重偏向某些主题；模型排名在不同提示切片下存在差异；偏好判断的使用模糊了其原本意图范围；定性研究表明交互式方法能改善透明度。
AI.conclusion: 交互式可视化界面支持更情境化的模型评估，为替代性的LLM排行榜设计与使用方式提供了方向。

title: Component-Based Out-of-Distribution Detection
summary: Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection requires sensitivity to subtle shifts without overreacting to natural In-Distribution (ID) diversity. However, from the viewpoint of detection granularity, global representation inevitably suppress local OOD cues, while patch-based methods are unstable due to entangled spurious-correlation and noise. And neither them is effective in detecting compositional OODs composed of valid ID components. Inspired by recognition-by-components theory, we present a training-free Component-Based OOD Detection (CoOD) framework that addresses the existing limitations by decomposing inputs into functional components. To instantiate CoOD, we derive Component Shift Score (CSS) to detect local appearance shifts, and Compositional Consistency Score (CCS) to identify cross-component compositional inconsistencies. Empirically, CoOD achieves consistent improvements on both coarse- and fine-grained OOD detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoOD框架，通过将输入分解为功能组件，利用组件偏移分数（CSS）检测局部外观变化和组合一致性分数（CCS）识别跨组件组合不一致性，在粗粒度和细粒度OOD检测上均取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有OOD检测方法存在全局表征抑制局部异常线索、基于patch的方法受虚假相关和噪声干扰不稳定、且难以有效检测由有效ID组件组成的组合式OOD等问题。
AI.method: 基于组件识别理论，提出免训练的组件式OOD检测框架CoOD，通过CSS检测局部外观偏移，通过CCS识别跨组件组合不一致性。
AI.result: 在粗粒度和细粒度OOD检测任务上均实现一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 组件化分解方法能有效弥补全局和局部检测方法的不足，提升OOD检测的细粒度与组合性识别能力。

title: Why are all LLMs Obsessed with Japanese Culture? On the Hidden Cultural and Regional Biases of LLMs
summary: LLMs have been showing limitations when it comes to cultural coverage and competence, and in some cases show regional biases such as amplifying Western and Anglocentric viewpoints. While there have been works analysing the cultural capabilities of LLMs, there has not been specific work on highlighting LLM regional preferences when it comes to cultural-related questions. In this work, we propose a new dataset based on a comprehensive taxonomy of Culture-Related Open Questions (CROQ). The results show that, contrary to previous cultural bias work, LLMs show a clear tendency towards countries such as Japan. Moveover, our results show that when prompting in languages such as English or other high-resource ones, LLMs tend to provide more diverse outputs and show less inclinations towards answering questions highlighting countries for which the input language is an official language. Finally, we also investigate at which point of LLM training this cultural bias emerges, with our results suggesting that the first clear signs appear after supervised fine-tuning, and not during pre-training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CROQ数据集，发现LLMs在文化相关问题上偏好日本，且高资源语言提示能增加输出多样性；文化偏见在监督微调阶段首次显现。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏系统分析LLMs在文化相关问题上的区域性偏好，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 基于文化相关开放问题（CROQ）的综合分类法构建新数据集，分析LLMs在不同语言提示下的文化倾向，并追踪偏见出现阶段。
AI.result: LLMs明显偏好日本；高资源语言（如英语）提示下输出更多样，且较少偏向官方语言国；文化偏见在监督微调后首次明显出现。
AI.conclusion: LLMs存在非西方中心的文化偏好（日本倾向），语言策略可调节输出多样性，训练阶段的微调是关键偏见来源。

title: Deep kernel video approximation for unsupervised action segmentation
summary: This work focuses on per-video unsupervised action segmentation, which is of interest to applications where storing large datasets is either not possible, or nor permitted. We propose to segment videos by learning in deep kernel space, to approximate the underlying frame distribution, as closely as possible. To define this closeness metric between the original video distribution and its approximation, we rely on maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) which is a geometry-preserving metric in distribution space, and thus gives more reliable estimates. Moreover, unlike the commonly used optimal transport metric, MMD is both easier to optimize, and faster. We choose to use neural tangent kernels (NTKs) to define the kernel space where MMD operates, because of their improved descriptive power as opposed to fixed kernels. And, also, because NTKs sidestep the trivial solution, when jointly learning the inputs (video approximation) and the kernel function. Finally, we show competitive results when compared to state-of-the-art per-video methods, on six standard benchmarks. Additionally, our method has higher F1 scores than prior agglomerative work, when the number of segments is unknown.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于每视频的无监督动作分割方法，通过神经正切核（NTK）和最大均值差异（MMD）在深度核空间中近似视频帧分布，在六个基准上取得了竞争性结果，且在未知分割数时F1分数优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 在无法或不允许存储大规模数据集的场景下，需要对单个视频进行无监督动作分割，现有方法在分布逼近的可靠性和优化效率上存在不足。
AI.method: 使用最大均值差异（MMD）作为分布空间的几何保持度量来近似原始视频分布，并采用神经正切核（NTK）定义核空间，避免联合学习输入和核函数时的平凡解问题。
AI.result: 在六个标准基准上超越了现有每视频方法，且在未知分割数时相比先前的凝聚方法获得了更高的F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 基于NTK和MMD的深度核空间学习方法在无监督动作分割任务中有效且高效，尤其适用于存储受限的场景。

title: AUDITA: A New Dataset to Audit Humans vs. AI Skill at Audio QA
summary: Existing audio question answering benchmarks largely emphasize sound event classification or caption-grounded queries, often enabling models to succeed through shortcut strategies, short-duration cues, lexical priors, dataset-specific biases, or even bypassing audio via metadata and captions rather than genuine reasoning Thus, we present AUDITA (Audio Understanding from Diverse Internet Trivia Authors), a large-scale, real-world benchmark to rigorously evaluate audio reasoning beyond surface-level acoustic recognition. AUDITA comprises carefully curated, human-authored trivia questions grounded in real-world audio, designed to stress robust auditory reasoning through challenging distractors and long-range temporal dependencies, using probing queries that cannot be answered from isolated text or sound cues alone. Human average accuracy of 32.13% shows both the challenge of the task while demonstrating meaningful comprehension of the audio. In stark contrast, state of-the-art audio question answering models perform poorly, with average accuracy below 8.86%. Beyond raw accuracy, we apply Item Response Theory (IRT) to estimate latent proficiency, question difficulty, and expose systematic deficiencies of the models and data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AUDITA，一个基于真实世界网络琐事的大规模音频问答基准。人类平均准确率仅32.13%，而最先进的音频问答模型准确率低于8.86%，表明现有模型在真实音频推理任务上表现极差。
AI.motivation: 现有音频问答基准多偏向声音事件分类或基于字幕的查询，模型可通过捷径策略、短时线索、词汇先验、数据集偏差甚至绕过音频（利用元数据或字幕）来完成任务，缺乏真正的音频推理能力检验。
AI.method: 构建了AUDITA基准，包含人工撰写的真实世界音频琐事问答，设计具有挑战性的干扰项和长程时间依赖，并采用项目反应理论（IRT）评估潜在能力与问题难度。
AI.result: 人类平均准确率32.13%，而最先进的音频问答模型平均准确率低于8.86%，模型存在系统性缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 当前音频问答模型在真实音频推理任务上远未达到人类水平，AUDITA可作为评估和推动该领域发展的有效基准。

title: Learning to Communicate: Toward End-to-End Optimization of Multi-Agent Language Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems built on large language models have shown strong performance on complex reasoning tasks, yet most work focuses on agent roles and orchestration while treating inter-agent communication as a fixed interface. Latent communication through internal representations such as key-value caches offers a promising alternative to text-based protocols, but existing approaches do not jointly optimize communication with multi-agent reasoning. Therefore we propose DiffMAS, a training framework that treats latent communication as a learnable component of multi-agent systems. DiffMAS performs parameter-efficient supervised training over multi-agent latent trajectories, enabling agents to jointly learn how information should be encoded and interpreted across interactions. Experiments on mathematical reasoning, scientific QA, code generation, and commonsense benchmarks show that DiffMAS consistently improves reasoning accuracy and decoding stability over single-agent inference, text-based multi-agent systems, and prior latent communication methods, achieving 26.7% on AIME24, 20.2% on GPQA-Diamond, and consistent gains across reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出DiffMAS框架，将多智能体系统中的潜在通信作为可学习组件，通过参数高效监督训练联合优化通信与推理，在数学、科学问答、代码生成等任务上优于单智能体和文本多智能体方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统大多将智能体间通信视为固定接口（如文本协议），未将潜在通信（如KV缓存）与多智能体推理联合优化，缺乏可学习的通信机制。
AI.method: 提出DiffMAS训练框架，将潜在通信作为可学习组件，对多智能体潜在轨迹进行参数高效的监督训练，使智能体联合学习信息编码与跨交互解读。
AI.result: 在AIME24上达26.7%，GPQA-Diamond上达20.2%，在数学推理、科学问答、代码生成和常识基准测试中一致优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 可学习的潜在通信机制能有效提升多智能体系统的推理准确性和解码稳定性。

title: Misinformation Span Detection in Videos via Audio Transcripts
summary:
Online misinformation is one of the most challenging issues lately, yielding severe consequences, including political polarization, attacks on democracy, and public health risks. Misinformation manifests in any platform with a large user base, including online social networks and messaging apps. It permeates all media and content forms, including images, text, audio, and video. Distinctly, video-based misinformation represents a multifaceted challenge for fact-checkers, given the ease with which individuals can record and upload videos on various video-sharing platforms. Previous research efforts investigated detecting video-based misinformation, focusing on whether a video shares misinformation or not on a video level. While this approach is useful, it only provides a limited and non-easily interpretable view of the problem given that it does not provide an additional context of when misinformation occurs within videos and what content (i.e., claims) are responsible for the video's misinformation nature.
  In this work, we attempt to bridge this research gap by creating two novel datasets that allow us to explore misinformation detection on videos via audio transcripts, focusing on identifying the span of videos that are responsible for the video's misinformation claim (misinformation span detection). We present two new datasets for this task. We transcribe each video's audio to text, identifying the video segment in which the misinformation claims appears, resulting in two datasets of more than 500 videos with over 2,400 segments containing annotated fact-checked claims. Then, we employ classifiers built with state-of-the-art language models, and our results show that we can identify in which part of a video there is misinformation with an F1 score of 0.68. We make publicly available our annotated datasets. We also release all transcripts, audio and videos.

AI.tldr: 本文针对视频中 misinformation 的细粒度检测，提出了两个新数据集，通过音频转录文本识别 misinformation 出现的具体片段（span detection），并使用先进语言模型实现了 F1 分数 0.68 的检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视频 misinformation 检测仅在视频层面判断是否含有虚假信息，缺乏对 misinformation 具体出现位置与内容（即 claim）的细粒度识别，解释性不足。本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1) 创建两个新数据集，包含 500+ 视频和 2400+ 经过事实核查标注的片段；2) 将视频音频转录为文本；3) 标注 misinformation 出现的视频片段（span）；4) 使用基于 SOTA 语言模型的分类器进行检测。
AI.result: 在 misinformation 片段检测任务上实现 F1 分数 0.68。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够有效识别视频中 misinformation 的具体位置，提供了比视频级检测更细粒度、更可解释的解决方案，并公开了数据集、转录文本、音频和视频资源以促进后续研究。

title: Tool Attention Is All You Need: Dynamic Tool Gating and Lazy Schema Loading for Eliminating the MCP/Tools Tax in Scalable Agentic Workflows
summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become a common interface for connecting large language model (LLM) agents to external tools, but its reliance on stateless, eager schema injection imposes a hidden per-turn overhead the MCP Tax or Tools Tax that practitioner reports place between roughly 10k and 60k tokens in typical multi-server deployments. This payload inflates the key-value cache, is associated with reasoning degradation as context utilization approaches published fracture points around 70%, and turns token budgets into a recurring operational cost. We introduce Tool Attention, a middleware-layer mechanism that generalizes the "Attention Is All You Need" paradigm from self-attention over tokens to gated attention over tools. Tool Attention combines (i) an Intent Schema Overlap (ISO) score from sentence embeddings, (ii) a state-aware gating function enforcing preconditions and access scopes, and (iii) a two-phase lazy schema loader that keeps a compact summary pool in context and promotes full JSON schemas only for top-k gated tools. We evaluate on a simulated 120-tool, six-server benchmark whose per-server token counts are calibrated to public audits of real MCP deployments. In this simulation, Tool Attention directly reduces measured per-turn tool tokens by 95.0% (47.3k -> 2.4k) and raises effective context utilization (a token-ratio quantity) from 24% to 91%. End-to-end figures for task success, latency, cost, and reasoning quality are reported as projections derived from the measured token counts combined with published deployment telemetry; they are not measured on live LLM agents, and we mark projected values explicitly throughout. Taken together, the results support a simple thesis: protocol-level efficiency, not raw context length, is a binding constraint on scalable gentic systems. The code for this work is accessible at https://github.com/asadani/tool-attention

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tool Attention，一种中间件机制，通过意图-模式重叠评分、状态门控和两阶段惰性加载，将MCP协议中每轮工具调用开销从47.3k tokens降至2.4k（降低95%），有效上下文利用率从24%提升至91%。
AI.motivation: MCP协议中工具描述（Tool Tax）每轮消耗1万至6万tokens，导致KV缓存膨胀、推理质量下降（上下文利用率接近70%断裂点），且token费用成为持续性运营成本。现有方案依赖扩大上下文窗口，而非优化协议层效率。
AI.method: （i）意图-模式重叠（ISO）分数：通过句子嵌入计算用户意图与工具模式的相关性；（ii）状态感知门控函数：强制执行前置条件和访问范围约束；（iii）两阶段惰性加载：在上下文中保留紧凑摘要池，仅将前k个门控工具的全量JSON模式加载到上下文中。
AI.result: 在120个工具、6个服务器的模拟基准测试中，每轮工具tokens减少95.0%（47.3k→2.4k），有效上下文利用率从24%提升至91%。任务成功率、延迟、成本和推理质量等端到端指标为基于token计数和公开部署遥测的投影值，非实测数据。
AI.conclusion: 协议级效率（而非原始上下文长度）是可扩展智能体系统的关键约束。

title: SemEval-2026 Task 4: Narrative Story Similarity and Narrative Representation Learning
summary: We present the shared task on narrative similarity and narrative representation learning - NSNRL (pronounced "nass-na-rel"). The task operationalizes narrative similarity as a binary classification problem: determining which of two stories is more similar to an anchor story. We introduce a novel definition of narrative similarity, compatible with both narrative theory and intuitive judgment. Based on the similarity judgments collected under this concept, we also evaluate narrative embedding representations. We collected at least two annotations each for more than 1,000 story summary triples, with each annotation being backed by at least two annotators in agreement. This paper describes the sampling and annotation process for the dataset; further, we give an overview of the submitted systems and the techniques they employ. We received a total of 71 final submissions from 46 teams across our two tracks. In our triple-based classification setup, LLM ensembles make up many of the top-scoring systems, while in the embedding setup, systems with pre- and post-processing on pretrained embedding models perform about on par with custom fine-tuned solutions. Our analysis identifies potential headroom for improvement of automated systems in both tracks. The task website includes visualizations of embeddings alongside instance-level classification results for all teams.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个关于叙事相似性与叙事表征学习的共享任务（NSNRL），基于超过1000个故事摘要三元组的人类标注数据，评估了71个系统在二元分类与嵌入表征两个赛道上的表现，发现LLM集成在分类任务中表现最佳，而嵌入赛道中预训练模型的后处理与微调方案效果相当。
AI.motivation: 从叙事理论和直觉判断出发，提出一种新的叙事相似性定义，并构建相应数据集以推动叙事表征学习的研究。
AI.method: 将叙事相似性操作化为二元分类问题（判断两个故事中哪一个与锚点故事更相似），收集超过1000个故事摘要三元组的人工标注（每个标注至少两人一致同意），并分别设置三元组分类和嵌入表征两个评估赛道。
AI.result: 共收到46个团队的71份最终提交；LLM集成在分类赛道中占据多数顶尖系统；嵌入赛道中预训练模型的后处理/预处理方案与定制微调方案表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 两个赛道均存在提升空间，任务网站提供了所有团队的嵌入可视化与实例级分类结果。

title: Alignment has a Fantasia Problem
summary: Modern AI assistants are trained to follow instructions, implicitly assuming that users can clearly articulate their goals and the kind of assistance they need. Decades of behavioral research, however, show that people often engage with AI systems before their goals are fully formed. When AI systems treat prompts as complete expressions of intent, they can appear to be useful or convenient, but not necessarily aligned with the users' needs. We call these failures Fantasia interactions. We argue that Fantasia interactions demand a rethinking of alignment research: rather than treating users as rational oracles, AI should provide cognitive support by actively helping users form and refine their intent through time. This requires an interdisciplinary approach that bridges machine learning, interface design, and behavioral science. We synthesize insights from these fields to characterize the mechanisms and failures of Fantasia interactions. We then show why existing interventions are insufficient, and propose a research agenda for designing and evaluating AI systems that better help humans navigate uncertainty in their tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现代AI助手将用户指令视为完整意图表达存在缺陷，提出"Fantasia交互"概念——用户在目标未完全形成时与AI互动导致的失败，主张AI应主动帮助用户形成和完善意图，而非被动执行指令。
AI.motivation: 大量行为研究表明，用户常在目标尚未完全形成时与AI系统交互，而现有AI将提示词视为完整意图表达，导致看似有用实则与用户真实需求错位的失败。
AI.method: 综合机器学习、界面设计和行为科学三个领域的见解，描述Fantasia交互的机制和失败模式，分析现有干预措施的不足，提出新的研究议程。
AI.result: 识别了"Fantasia交互"这一新型对齐失败模式，论证了现有对齐研究将用户视为理性预言家的假设存在问题。
AI.conclusion: AI对齐研究需要重新思考：不应将用户视为理性预言家，而应通过跨学科方法设计能够帮助用户在任务中导航不确定性的AI系统。

title: Sculpt4D: Generating 4D Shapes via Sparse-Attention Diffusion Transformers
summary: Recent breakthroughs in 3D generative modeling have yielded remarkable progress in static shape synthesis, yet high-fidelity dynamic 4D generation remains elusive, hindered by temporal artifacts and prohibitive computational demand. We present Sculpt4D, a native 4D generative framework that seamlessly integrates efficient temporal modeling into a pretrained 3D Diffusion Transformer (Hunyuan3D 2.1), thereby mitigating the scarcity of 4D training data. At its core lies a Block Sparse Attention mechanism that preserves object identity by anchoring to the initial frame while capturing rich motion dynamics via a time-decaying sparse mask. This design faithfully models complex spatiotemporal dependencies with high fidelity, while sidestepping the quadratic overhead of full attention and reducing network total computation by 56%. Consequently, Sculpt4D establishes a new state-of-the-art in temporally coherent 4D synthesis and charts a path toward efficient and scalable 4D generation.

AI.tldr: Sculpt4D提出了一种原生4D生成框架，通过将高效时序建模集成到预训练的3D扩散Transformer中，并引入块稀疏注意力机制，在保持物体身份一致性的同时捕获丰富运动动态，减少56%网络计算量，实现最先进的时序一致4D合成。
AI.motivation: 现有4D生成存在时间伪影和计算开销大的问题，且4D训练数据稀缺，亟需高效且可扩展的4D生成方法。
AI.method: 基于预训练3D扩散Transformer（Hunyuan3D 2.1），引入块稀疏注意力机制，通过时间衰减稀疏掩码锚定初始帧来保持物体身份，同时捕获运动动态，避免全注意力的二次复杂度。
AI.result: 减少网络总计算量56%，在时序一致的4D合成上达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: Sculpt4D为高效、可扩展的4D生成开辟了新路径，证明了将时序建模融入预训练3D模型的有效性。

title: Machine Behavior in Relational Moral Dilemmas: Moral Rightness, Predicted Human Behavior, and Model Decisions
summary: Human moral judgment is context-dependent and modulated by interpersonal relationships. As large language models (LLMs) increasingly function as decision-support systems, determining whether they encode these social nuances is critical. We characterize machine behavior using the Whistleblower's Dilemma by varying two experimental dimensions: crime severity and relational closeness. Our study evaluates three distinct perspectives: (1) moral rightness (prescriptive norms), (2) predicted human behavior (descriptive social expectations), and (3) autonomous model decision-making. By analyzing the reasoning processes, we identify a clear cross-perspective divergence: while moral rightness remains consistently fairness-oriented, predicted human behavior shifts significantly toward loyalty as relational closeness increases. Crucially, model decisions align with moral rightness judgments rather than their own behavioral predictions. This inconsistency suggests that LLM decision-making prioritizes rigid, prescriptive rules over the social sensitivity present in their internal world-modeling, which poses a gap that may lead to significant misalignments in real-world deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文通过"举报者困境"实验，研究了LLM在道德判断中如何处理犯罪严重性和人际关系亲密度两个维度，发现模型在道德正确性判断上保持公平导向，但在预测人类行为时随关系亲密增加偏向忠诚，而模型自主决策更遵循刻板规则而非自身预测的社会行为模式，存在对齐偏差。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地用于决策支持系统，但其是否编码了人类道德判断中的社会语境依赖性和人际关系调节机制尚不清楚，需要系统评估。
AI.method: 使用"举报者困境"范式，通过犯罪严重性和关系亲密度两个实验维度，分别从道德正确性（规范性）、预测人类行为（描述性社会期望）和模型自主决策三个视角进行对比分析。
AI.result: 道德正确性始终保持公平导向；预测的人类行为随关系亲密增加显著转向忠诚导向；模型自主决策倾向于遵循道德正确性而非自身的行为预测，呈现出跨视角的不一致性。
AI.conclusion: LLM的决策机制优先遵循僵化的规范性规则，忽略了其内部世界模型中存在的社会敏感性，这一差距可能导致在实际部署中出现严重的对齐问题。

title: Local Neighborhood Instability in Parametric Projections: Quantitative and Visual Analysis
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, LaTeX, to appear at the 17th International EuroVis Workshop on Visual Analytics
summary: Parametric projections let analysts embed new points in real time, but input variations from measurement noise or data drift can produce unpredictable shifts in the 2D layout. Whether and where a projection is locally stable remains largely unexamined. In this paper, we present a stability evaluation framework that probes parametric projections with Gaussian perturbations around selected anchor points and assesses how neighborhoods deform in the 2D embedding. Our approach combines quantitative measures of mean displacement, bias, and nearest-anchor assignment error with per-anchor visualizations of displacement vectors, local PCA ellipsoids, and Voronoi misassignment for detailed inspection. We demonstrate the framework's effectiveness on UMAP- and t-SNE-based neural projectors of varying network sizes and study the effect of Jacobian regularization as a gradient-based robustness strategy. We apply our framework to the MNIST and Fashion-MNIST datasets. The results show that our framework identifies unstable projection regions invisible to reconstruction error or neighborhood-preservation metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种评估参数化投影局部稳定性的框架，通过高斯扰动和多种量化指标（平均位移、偏差、最近锚点分配误差）及可视化工具，揭示了UMAP和t-SNE神经投影器中的不稳定区域，这些区域无法被传统指标检测到。
AI.motivation: 参数化投影虽能实时嵌入新点，但测量噪声或数据漂移会导致2D布局产生不可预测的偏移，而投影的局部稳定性问题尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 对选定锚点施加高斯扰动，结合平均位移、偏差、最近锚点分配误差等量化指标，以及位移向量、局部PCA椭球、Voronoi误分配等可视化手段，评估UMAP和t-SNE神经投影器的稳定性，并研究Jacobian正则化的效果。
AI.result: 框架成功识别出传统重构误差和邻域保持指标无法发现的投影不稳定区域。
AI.conclusion: 该稳定性评估框架能有效检测参数化投影的局部不稳定区域，为提升投影可靠性提供了新的分析工具。

title: Revisiting Non-Verbatim Memorization in Large Language Models: The Role of Entity Surface Forms
summary: Understanding what kinds of factual knowledge large language models (LLMs) memorize is essential for evaluating their reliability and limitations. Entity-based QA is a common framework for analyzing non-verbatim memorization, but typical evaluations query each entity using a single canonical surface form, making it difficult to disentangle fact memorization from access through a particular name. We introduce RedirectQA, an entity-based QA dataset that uses Wikipedia redirect information to associate Wikidata factual triples with categorized surface forms for each entity, including alternative names, abbreviations, spelling variants, and common erroneous forms. Across 13 LLMs, we examine surface-conditioned factual memorization and find that prediction outcomes often change when only the entity surface form changes. This inconsistency is category-dependent: models are more robust to minor orthographic variations than to larger lexical variations such as aliases and abbreviations. Frequency analyses further suggest that both entity- and surface-level frequencies are associated with accuracy, and that entity frequency often contributes beyond surface frequency. Overall, factual memorization appears neither purely surface-specific nor fully surface-invariant, highlighting the importance of surface-form diversity in evaluating non-verbatim memorization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RedirectQA数据集，通过维基百科重定向信息为实体提供多种表面形式（别名、缩写、拼写变体、常见错误形式），测试13个大语言模型后发现：模型的事实记忆会随实体表面形式变化而改变，且这种不一致性与表面形式类别相关。实体频率和表面频率均影响准确率，事实记忆既非完全表面特异也非完全表面不变。
AI.motivation: 现有实体问答评估通常使用单一规范表面形式，无法区分模型是真正记忆了事实还是仅通过特定名称访问知识，因此需要引入多样化表面形式来更准确地评估大模型的事实记忆能力。
AI.method: 基于维基百科重定向信息构建RedirectQA数据集，将Wikidata事实三元组与实体的多种表面形式（替代名称、缩写、拼写变体、常见错误形式）关联。在13个大语言模型上进行表面条件化的事实记忆实验，分析不同表面形式下预测结果的一致性。
AI.result: 模型预测结果随实体表面形式改变而改变，这种不一致性具有类别依赖性：对轻微拼写变体更鲁棒，对别名和缩写等较大词汇变化更敏感。实体频率和表面频率均与准确率相关，且实体频率的贡献常超出表面频率。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型的事实记忆既非完全表面特异也非完全表面不变，评估非逐字记忆时需要考虑表面形式的多样性。

title: Nemobot Games: Crafting Strategic AI Gaming Agents for Interactive Learning with Large Language Models
summary: This paper introduces a new paradigm for AI game programming, leveraging large language models (LLMs) to extend and operationalize Claude Shannon's taxonomy of game-playing machines. Central to this paradigm is Nemobot, an interactive agentic engineering environment that enables users to create, customize, and deploy LLM-powered game agents while actively engaging with AI-driven strategies. The LLM-based chatbot, integrated within Nemobot, demonstrates its capabilities across four distinct classes of games. For dictionary-based games, it compresses state-action mappings into efficient, generalized models for rapid adaptability. In rigorously solvable games, it employs mathematical reasoning to compute optimal strategies and generates human-readable explanations for its decisions. For heuristic-based games, it synthesizes strategies by combining insights from classical minimax algorithms (see, e.g., shannon1950chess) with crowd-sourced data. Finally, in learning-based games, it utilizes reinforcement learning with human feedback and self-critique to iteratively refine strategies through trial-and-error and imitation learning. Nemobot amplifies this framework by offering a programmable environment where users can experiment with tool-augmented generation and fine-tuning of strategic game agents. From strategic games to role-playing games, Nemobot demonstrates how AI agents can achieve a form of self-programming by integrating crowdsourced learning and human creativity to iteratively refine their own logic. This represents a step toward the long-term goal of self-programming AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Nemobot框架，利用大语言模型扩展Shannon的游戏机器分类法，实现AI游戏代理的创建、定制和部署，涵盖四类游戏并朝自我编程AI迈进一步。
AI.motivation: 探索大语言模型在游戏编程中的新范式，扩展Shannon经典分类法，实现AI代理的自我编程能力。
AI.method: 构建Nemobot交互式工程环境，集成LLM聊天机器人，针对字典游戏、严格可解游戏、启发式游戏和学习类游戏分别采用状态压缩、数学推理、经典算法+众包数据、强化学习+人类反馈等方法。
AI.result: Nemobot在四类游戏中均展现出有效能力，支持工具增强生成和策略微调，实现了类自我编程的迭代优化。
AI.conclusion: Nemobot框架证明了LLM驱动的游戏代理能够通过众包学习和人类创造力实现逻辑的迭代自优化，是迈向自我编程AI的重要一步。

title: DCMorph: Face Morphing via Dual-Stream Cross-Attention Diffusion
summary: Advancing face morphing attack techniques is crucial to anticipate evolving threats and develop robust defensive mechanisms for identity verification systems. This work introduces DCMorph, a dual-stream diffusion-based morphing framework that simultaneously operates at both identity conditioning and latent space levels. Unlike image-level methods suffering from blending artifacts or GAN-based approaches with limited reconstruction fidelity, DCMorph leverages identity-conditioned latent diffusion models through two mechanisms: (1) decoupled cross-attention interpolation that injects identity-specific features from both source faces into the denoising process, enabling explicit dual-identity conditioning absent in existing diffusion-based methods, and (2) DDIM inversion with spherical interpolation between inverted latent representations from both source faces, providing geometrically consistent initial latent representation that preserves structural attributes. Vulnerability analyses across four state-of-the-art face recognition systems demonstrate that DCMorph achieves the highest attack success rates compared to existing methods at both operational thresholds, while remaining challenging to detect by current morphing attack detection solutions.

AI.tldr: DCMorph是一个基于双流扩散的人脸变形攻击框架，通过解耦交叉注意力插值和DDIM反演球面插值实现双重身份条件控制，在四个SOTA人脸识别系统上取得了最高的攻击成功率，且难以被现有检测方案识别。
AI.motivation: 现有图像级变形方法存在融合伪影，GAN方法重建保真度有限，且已有扩散方法缺乏显式双重身份条件控制。开发更逼真的变形攻击技术对于预判安全威胁和构建鲁棒防御机制至关重要。
AI.method: 提出DCMorph双流扩散变形框架：(1) 解耦交叉注意力插值机制，将两个源人脸的身份特征注入去噪过程，实现显式双重身份条件化；(2) DDIM反演结合球面插值，在两个源人脸的反演潜表示之间进行几何一致的初始潜表示融合。
AI.result: 在四个SOTA人脸识别系统上，DCMorph在两种操作阈值下均实现最高攻击成功率，且现有变形攻击检测方案难以有效检测。
AI.conclusion: DCMorph通过双流扩散设计有效提升了人脸变形攻击的逼真度和攻击成功率，为评估和提升人脸识别系统的安全性提供了新的基准方法。

title: A Multimodal Text- and Graph-Based Approach for Open-Domain Event Extraction from Documents
summary: Event extraction is essential for event understanding and analysis. It supports tasks such as document summarization and decision-making in emergency scenarios. However, existing event extraction approaches have limitations: (1) closed-domain algorithms are restricted to predefined event types and thus rarely generalize to unseen types and (2) open-domain event extraction algorithms, capable of handling unconstrained event types, have largely overlooked the potential of large language models (LLMs) despite their advanced abilities. Additionally, they do not explicitly model document-level contextual, structural, and semantic reasoning, which are crucial for effective event extraction but remain challenging for LLMs due to lost-in-the-middle phenomenon and attention dilution. To address these limitations, we propose multimodal open-domain event extraction, MODEE , a novel approach for open-domain event extraction that combines graph-based learning with text-based representation from LLMs to model document-level reasoning. Empirical evaluations on large datasets demonstrate that MODEE outperforms state-of-the-art open-domain event extraction approaches and can be generalized to closed-domain event extraction, where it outperforms existing algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MODEE方法，结合图学习与LLM文本表示，解决开放域事件提取中缺乏文档级推理和LLM应用不足的问题，在开放域和封闭域事件提取任务上均实现了最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有事件提取方法存在两个局限：(1)封闭域方法受限于预定义事件类型，难以泛化到未见类型；(2)开放域方法忽略了LLM的潜力，且未显式建模文档级的上下文、结构和语义推理，LLM面临"中间丢失"和注意力稀释问题。
AI.method: 提出多模态开放域事件提取(MODEE)方法，将基于图的文档级推理学习与来自LLM的文本表示相结合，实现开放域事件提取。
AI.result: 在大型数据集上的实验表明，MODEE在开放域事件提取上优于现有最优方法，并能泛化到封闭域事件提取任务，同样超越现有算法。
AI.conclusion: 图学习与LLM文本表示的融合能有效解决开放域事件提取的文档级推理难题，且该方法具有良好的泛化能力，可适用于封闭域场景。

title: From Research Question to Scientific Workflow: Leveraging Agentic AI for Science Automation
summary: Scientific workflow systems automate execution -- scheduling, fault tolerance, resource management -- but not the semantic translation that precedes it. Scientists still manually convert research questions into workflow specifications, a task requiring both domain knowledge and infrastructure expertise. We propose an agentic architecture that closes this gap through three layers: an LLM interprets natural language into structured intents (semantic layer); validated generators produce reproducible workflow DAGs (deterministic layer); and domain experts author ``Skills'': markdown documents encoding vocabulary mappings, parameter constraints, and optimization strategies (knowledge layer). This decomposition confines LLM non-determinism to intent extraction: identical intents always yield identical workflows. We implement and evaluate the architecture on the 1000 Genomes population genetics workflow and Hyperflow WMS running on Kubernetes. In an ablation study on 150 queries, Skills raise full-match intent accuracy from 44% to 83%; skill-driven deferred workflow generation reduces data transfer by 92\%; and the end-to-end pipeline completes queries on Kubernetes with LLM overhead below 15 seconds and cost under $0.001 per query.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种三层智能体架构，用LLM将自然语言转化为结构化意图，再通过确定性生成器和领域知识（Skills）生成可复现的工作流DAG，在1000 Genomes基因组学工作流上验证，意图准确率从44%提升至83%，数据传输减少92%，单次查询成本低于0.001美元。
AI.motivation: 现有的科学工作流系统虽然自动化了执行、调度和容错，但无法自动将研究问题转化为工作流规范，科学家仍需手动完成这一依赖领域知识和基础设施专业知识的语义翻译过程。
AI.method: 提出一个三层智能体架构：(1) 语义层——LLM将自然语言解析为结构化意图；(2) 确定性层——经过验证的生成器产生可复现的工作流DAG；(3) 知识层——领域专家撰写"Skills"（Markdown文档，编码词汇映射、参数约束和优化策略）。这种分解将LLM的非确定性限制在意图提取阶段，相同意图始终产生相同工作流。
AI.result: 在150个查询的消融研究中，Skills将完全匹配的意图准确率从44%提升至83%；技能驱动的延迟工作流生成将数据传输减少92%；端到端流水线在Kubernetes上完成查询，LLM开销低于15秒，单次查询成本低于0.001美元。
AI.conclusion: 通过将LLM的非确定性限制在意图提取阶段，结合领域专家编写的Skills和确定性工作流生成器，能够高效、低成本地将自然语言研究问题转化为可复现的科学工作流，在基因组学工作流上验证了该方法的有效性。

title: DualSplat: Robust 3D Gaussian Splatting via Pseudo-Mask Bootstrapping from Reconstruction Failures
comment: 10 pages,6 figures, accepted to Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Conference 2026
summary: While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieves real-time photorealistic rendering, its performance degrades significantly when training images contain transient objects that violate multi-view consistency. Existing methods face a circular dependency: accurate transient detection requires a well-reconstructed static scene, while clean reconstruction itself depends on reliable transient masks. We address this challenge with DualSplat, a Failure-to-Prior framework that converts first-pass reconstruction failures into explicit priors for a second reconstruction stage. We observe that transients, which appear in only a subset of views, often manifest as incomplete fragments during conservative initial training. We exploit these failures to construct object-level pseudo-masks by combining photometric residuals, feature mismatches, and SAM2 instance boundaries. These pseudo-masks then guide a clean second-pass 3DGS optimization, while a lightweight MLP refines them online by gradually shifting from prior supervision to self-consistency. Experiments on RobustNeRF and NeRF On-the-go show that DualSplat outperforms existing baselines, demonstrating particularly clear advantages in transient-heavy scenes and transient regions.

AI.tldr: DualSplat提出了一种Failure-to-Prior框架，通过将首次3DGS重建中因瞬态物体导致的失败结果转化为显式先验，并利用伪掩码引导第二阶段干净重建，从而有效处理多视图不一致问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法面临循环依赖：准确的瞬态检测需要良好的静态场景重建，而干净的重建又依赖可靠的瞬态掩码。3DGS在训练图像包含瞬态物体时性能严重下降。
AI.method: 1) 保守初始训练中利用瞬态物体在少数视角出现、表现为不完整碎片的特点；2) 结合光度残差、特征不匹配和SAM2实例边界构建物体级伪掩码；3) 利用伪掩码引导第二遍干净3DGS优化；4) 轻量级MLP在线优化掩码，从先验监督逐步过渡到自一致性。
AI.result: 在RobustNeRF和NeRF On-the-go数据集上，DualSplat优于现有基线方法，在瞬态密集场景和瞬态区域表现尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: Failure-to-Prior框架有效打破了瞬态检测与静态重建之间的循环依赖，利用重建失败本身作为先验信息，显著提升了3DGS在复杂场景下的鲁棒性。

title: EVENT5Ws: A Large Dataset for Open-Domain Event Extraction from Documents
summary: Event extraction identifies the central aspects of events from text. It supports event understanding and analysis, which is crucial for tasks such as informed decision-making in emergencies. Therefore, it is necessary to develop automated event extraction approaches. However, existing datasets for algorithm development have limitations, including limited coverage of event types in closed-domain settings and a lack of large, manually verified dataset in open-domain settings. To address these limitations, we create EVENT5Ws , a large, manually annotated, and statistically verified open-domain event extraction dataset. We design a systematic annotation pipeline to create the dataset and provide empirical insights into annotation complexity. Using EVENT5Ws, we evaluate state-of-the-art pre-trained large language models and establish a benchmark for future research. We further show that models trained on EVENT5Ws generalize effectively to datasets from different geographical contexts, which demonstrates its potential for developing generalizable algorithms. Finally, we summarize the lessons learned during the dataset development and provide recommendations to support future large-scale dataset development.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个名为EVENT5Ws的大规模、人工标注、统计验证的开放域事件抽取数据集，系统评估了现有大语言模型在此基准上的表现，并证明了其良好的跨地域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有事件抽取数据集存在局限：封闭域下事件类型覆盖有限，开放域下缺乏大规模人工验证的数据集。为支持自动化事件抽取算法的发展，需要解决这一数据瓶颈。
AI.method: 设计了系统化的注释流程来创建EVENT5Ws数据集；基于该数据集评估了多种先进预训练大语言模型，并建立了基准；通过跨地域数据集验证了模型的泛化能力。
AI.result: 成功构建了大规模、人工标注、统计验证的开放域事件抽取数据集；评估了SOTA大语言模型的表现；证明了在该数据集上训练的模型能够有效泛化到不同地理背景的数据集。
AI.conclusion: EVENT5Ws为开放域事件抽取提供了高质量基准，支持通用算法开发；总结的数据集开发经验可为未来大规模数据集建设提供指导。

title: Encoder-Free Human Motion Understanding via Structured Motion Descriptions
summary: The world knowledge and reasoning capabilities of text-based large language models (LLMs) are advancing rapidly, yet current approaches to human motion understanding, including motion question answering and captioning, have not fully exploited these capabilities. Existing LLM-based methods typically learn motion-language alignment through dedicated encoders that project motion features into the LLM's embedding space, remaining constrained by cross-modal representation and alignment. Inspired by biomechanical analysis, where joint angles and body-part kinematics have long served as a precise descriptive language for human movement, we propose \textbf{Structured Motion Description (SMD)}, a rule-based, deterministic approach that converts joint position sequences into structured natural language descriptions of joint angles, body part movements, and global trajectory. By representing motion as text, SMD enables LLMs to apply their pretrained knowledge of body parts, spatial directions, and movement semantics directly to motion reasoning, without requiring learned encoders or alignment modules. We show that this approach goes beyond state-of-the-art results on both motion question answering (66.7\% on BABEL-QA, 90.1\% on HuMMan-QA) and motion captioning (R@1 of 0.584, CIDEr of 53.16 on HumanML3D), surpassing all prior methods. SMD additionally offers practical benefits: the same text input works across different LLMs with only lightweight LoRA adaptation (validated on 8 LLMs from 6 model families), and its human-readable representation enables interpretable attention analysis over motion descriptions. Code, data, and pretrained LoRA adapters are available at https://yaozhang182.github.io/motion-smd/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结构化运动描述（SMD），一种将人体关节位置序列转化为结构化自然语言描述的规则驱动方法，使LLM能直接利用预训练知识进行运动推理，无需额外编码器，在运动问答和运动描述任务上超越所有现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的运动理解方法通常需要专用编码器学习运动-语言对齐，受限于跨模态表征和对齐。受生物力学分析启发，作者希望直接用结构化文本描述运动，让LLM发挥其预训练的身体部位、空间方向和运动语义知识。
AI.method: 提出结构化运动描述（SMD），一种基于规则、确定性的方法，将关节位置序列转换为关节角度、身体部位运动和全局轨迹的结构化自然语言描述，使运动以文本形式呈现给LLM。
AI.result: 在BABEL-QA上达到66.7%，HuMMan-QA上达到90.1%的准确率；HumanML3D上R@1为0.584，CIDEr为53.16，均超越所有先前方法。在8个不同LLM上仅需轻量LoRA微调即可工作。
AI.conclusion: SMD通过将运动表示为结构化文本，无需学习编码器或对齐模块即可实现SOTA性能，具有跨LLM通用性和可解释性等实际优势。

title: Sapiens2
summary: We present Sapiens2, a model family of high-resolution transformers for human-centric vision focused on generalization, versatility, and high-fidelity outputs. Our model sizes range from 0.4 to 5 billion parameters, with native 1K resolution and hierarchical variants that support 4K. Sapiens2 substantially improves over its predecessor in both pretraining and post-training. First, to learn features that capture low-level details (for dense prediction) and high-level semantics (for zero-shot or few-label settings), we combine masked image reconstruction with self-distilled contrastive objectives. Our evaluations show that this unified pretraining objective is better suited for a wider range of downstream tasks. Second, along the data axis, we pretrain on a curated dataset of 1 billion high-quality human images and improve the quality and quantity of task annotations. Third, architecturally, we incorporate advances from frontier models that enable longer training schedules with improved stability. Our 4K models adopt windowed attention to reason over longer spatial context and are pretrained with 2K output resolution. Sapiens2 sets a new state-of-the-art and improves over the first generation on pose (+4 mAP), body-part segmentation (+24.3 mIoU), normal estimation (45.6% lower angular error) and extends to new tasks such as pointmap and albedo estimation. Code: https://github.com/facebookresearch/sapiens2

AI.tldr: Sapiens2 是一个面向人体视觉的 Transformer 模型家族（0.4B-5B参数），支持原生1K分辨率及4K层次变体。通过统一掩码图像重建与自蒸馏对比目标的预训练策略、10亿高质量人体图像数据集以及改进的架构设计，在姿态估计、身体部位分割、法线估计等任务上达到新SOTA，并扩展至点图和反照率估计等新任务。
AI.motivation: 旨在提升面向人体视觉模型在泛化性、多任务适用性和高保真输出方面的表现，弥补前代Sapiens在预训练与后训练上的不足。
AI.method: 1) 统一预训练目标：结合掩码图像重建与自蒸馏对比学习；2) 数据轴：使用10亿高质量人体图像进行预训练，改进任务标注质量与数量；3) 架构优化：引入窗口注意力支持4K长空间上下文，采用2K输出分辨率预训练，提升训练稳定性。
AI.result: 姿态估计+4 mAP，身体部位分割+24.3 mIoU，法线估计角度误差降低45.6%，并扩展至点图和反照率估计任务。
AI.conclusion: Sapiens2通过统一预训练目标、大规模高质量数据及架构升级，显著超越前代并设立人体视觉新基准，代码已开源。

title: GiVA: Gradient-Informed Bases for Vector-Based Adaptation
summary: As model sizes continue to grow, parameter-efficient fine-tuning has emerged as a powerful alternative to full fine-tuning. While LoRA is widely adopted among these methods, recent research has explored vector-based adaptation methods due to their extreme parameter efficiency. However, these methods typically require substantially higher ranks than LoRA to match its performance, leading to increased training costs. This work introduces GiVA, a gradient-based initialization strategy for vector-based adaptation. It achieves training times comparable to LoRA and maintains the extreme parameter efficiency of vector-based adaptation. We evaluate GiVA across diverse benchmarks, including natural language understanding, natural language generation, and image classification. Experiments show that our approach consistently outperforms or achieves performance competitive with existing vector-based adaptation methods and LoRA while reducing rank requirements by a factor of eight ($8\times$).

AI.tldr: 提出GiVA方法，通过梯度基初始化策略解决向量适配方法在高秩下的训练成本问题，实现与LoRA相当的训练效率，同时保持极端参数效率，并将秩需求降低8倍。
AI.motivation: 现有向量适配方法虽参数效率极高，但需要比LoRA更高的秩才能匹配性能，导致训练成本增加。本文旨在解决这一效率与性能之间的权衡问题。
AI.method: 提出GiVA（Gradient-based Initialization for Vector-based Adaptation），一种基于梯度的初始化策略，用于向量适配方法。
AI.result: 在自然语言理解、自然语言生成和图像分类等基准测试中，GiVA一致优于或媲美现有向量适配方法和LoRA，同时将秩需求降低8倍。
AI.conclusion: GiVA成功结合了LoRA的训练效率和向量适配方法的极端参数效率，为大规模模型的参数高效微调提供了更优方案。

title: WorldMark: A Unified Benchmark Suite for Interactive Video World Models
summary: Interactive video generation models such as Genie, YUME, HY-World, and Matrix-Game are advancing rapidly, yet every model is evaluated on its own benchmark with private scenes and trajectories, making fair cross-model comparison impossible. Existing public benchmarks offer useful metrics such as trajectory error, aesthetic scores, and VLM-based judgments, but none supplies the standardized test conditions -- identical scenes, identical action sequences, and a unified control interface -- needed to make those metrics comparable across models with heterogeneous inputs. We introduce WorldMark, the first benchmark that provides such a common playing field for interactive Image-to-Video world models. WorldMark contributes: (1) a unified action-mapping layer that translates a shared WASD-style action vocabulary into each model's native control format, enabling apples-to-apples comparison across six major models on identical scenes and trajectories; (2) a hierarchical test suite of 500 evaluation cases covering first- and third-person viewpoints, photorealistic and stylized scenes, and three difficulty tiers from Easy to Hard spanning 20-60s; and (3) a modular evaluation toolkit for Visual Quality, Control Alignment, and World Consistency, designed so that researchers can reuse our standardized inputs while plugging in their own metrics as the field evolves. We will release all data, evaluation code, and model outputs to facilitate future research. Beyond offline metrics, we launch World Model Arena (warena.ai), an online platform where anyone can pit leading world models against each other in side-by-side battles and watch the live leaderboard.

AI.tldr: WorldMark是首个为交互式图像到视频世界模型提供统一测试基准的平台，通过标准化的场景、动作序列和控制接口，实现跨模型的公平对比。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式视频生成模型（如Genie、YUME等）各自使用私有基准进行评估，缺乏标准化测试条件，导致无法进行公平的跨模型比较。
AI.method: (1) 统一动作映射层：将WASD风格动作词汇翻译为各模型原生控制格式；(2) 分层测试套件：500个评估案例，涵盖第一/三人称视角、真实/风格化场景、三个难度等级；(3) 模块化评估工具包：包含视觉质量、控制对齐、世界一致性三个维度。
AI.result: 构建了首个标准化测试平台WorldMark，并推出在线竞技平台World Model Arena (warena.ai)，支持实时对比和排行榜。
AI.conclusion: WorldMark为交互式世界模型提供了公平比较的公共基准，并将开源所有数据、评估代码和模型输出，推动该领域研究发展。

title: MathDuels: Evaluating LLMs as Problem Posers and Solvers
summary: As frontier language models attain near-ceiling performance on static mathematical benchmarks, existing evaluations are increasingly unable to differentiate model capabilities, largely because they cast models solely as solvers of fixed problem sets. We introduce MathDuels, a self-play benchmark in which models occupy dual roles: each authors math problems under adversarial prompting and solves problems authored by every other participant. Problems are produced through a three-stage generation pipeline (meta-prompting, problem generation, and difficulty amplification), and validated by an independent verifier that excludes ill-posed questions. A Rasch model (Rasch, 1993) jointly estimates solver abilities and problem difficulties; author quality is derived from the difficulties of each model's authored problems. Experiments across 19 frontier models reveal that authoring and solving capabilities are partially decoupled, and that dual-role evaluation reveals capability separations invisible in single-role benchmarks. As newer models enter the arena, they produce problems that defeat previously dominant solvers, so the benchmark's difficulty co-evolves with participant strength rather than saturating at a fixed ceiling. We host a public leaderboard that updates as new models are released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MathDuels，一个让大模型同时扮演出题者和解题者的自对弈数学基准，揭示模型能力分离，且难度随参与者水平共同演化，避免静态基准的天花板效应。
AI.motivation: 现有静态数学基准难以区分前沿模型的能力差异，因为模型仅被当作固定题目的解答者。
AI.method: 通过三阶段生成流程（元提示、题目生成、难度放大）让模型出题，并用独立验证器排除病态问题；采用 Rasch 模型联合估计解题能力与题目难度，出题质量由模型所出题目的难度推导得出。
AI.result: 19 个前沿模型的实验表明，出题与解题能力部分解耦；双角色评估揭示了单角色基准无法区分的能力差异；新模型能生成击败此前主导模型的问题，基准难度随参与者实力共同演化。
AI.conclusion: MathDuels 通过自对弈双角色机制突破了静态基准的饱和限制，使评估难度与模型能力共同进化，提供了更持久的区分力。

title: Efficient Logic Gate Networks for Video Copy Detection
summary: Video copy detection requires robust similarity estimation under diverse visual distortions while operating at very large scale. Although deep neural networks achieve strong performance, their computational cost and descriptor size limit practical deployment in high-throughput systems. In this work, we propose a video copy detection framework based on differentiable Logic Gate Networks (LGNs), which replace conventional floating-point feature extractors with compact, logic-based representations. Our approach combines aggressive frame miniaturization, binary preprocessing, and a trainable LGN embedding model that learns both logical operations and interconnections. After training, the model can be discretized into a purely Boolean circuit, enabling extremely fast and memory-efficient inference. We systematically evaluate different similarity strategies, binarization schemes, and LGN architectures across multiple dataset folds and difficulty levels. Experimental results demonstrate that LGN-based models achieve competitive or superior accuracy and ranking performance compared to prior models, while producing descriptors several orders of magnitude smaller and delivering inference speeds exceeding 11k samples per second. These findings indicate that logic-based models offer a promising alternative for scalable and resource-efficient video copy detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于可微逻辑门网络（LGN）的视频拷贝检测框架，用紧凑的逻辑表示替代传统浮点特征提取器，训练后可离散化为纯布尔电路，在保持竞争力的同时显著降低描述子大小并实现极快推理速度（>11k样本/秒）。
AI.motivation: 现有深度神经网络在视频拷贝检测中性能优异，但计算成本和描述子体积过大，难以在大规模高吞吐系统中实际部署。
AI.method: 采用可微逻辑门网络（LGN）替代传统浮点特征提取器，结合激进的帧小型化、二值预处理和可训练LGN嵌入模型；训练后将模型离散化为纯布尔电路以实现高效推理。
AI.result: LGN模型在精度和排序性能上达到或超越现有方法，描述子体积小数个数量级，推理速度超过11,000样本/秒。
AI.conclusion: 基于逻辑的模型为可扩展且资源高效的视频拷贝检测提供了一种有前途的替代方案。

title: Building a Precise Video Language with Human-AI Oversight
summary: Video-language models (VLMs) learn to reason about the dynamic visual world through natural language. We introduce a suite of open datasets, benchmarks, and recipes for scalable oversight that enable precise video captioning. First, we define a structured specification for describing subjects, scenes, motion, spatial, and camera dynamics, grounded by hundreds of carefully defined visual primitives developed with professional video creators such as filmmakers. Next, to curate high-quality captions, we introduce CHAI (Critique-based Human-AI Oversight), a framework where trained experts critique and revise model-generated pre-captions into improved post-captions. This division of labor improves annotation accuracy and efficiency by offloading text generation to models, allowing humans to better focus on verification. Additionally, these critiques and preferences between pre- and post-captions provide rich supervision for improving open-source models (Qwen3-VL) on caption generation, reward modeling, and critique generation through SFT, DPO, and inference-time scaling. Our ablations show that critique quality in precision, recall, and constructiveness, ensured by our oversight framework, directly governs downstream performance. With modest expert supervision, the resulting model outperforms closed-source models such as Gemini-3.1-Pro. Finally, we apply our approach to re-caption large-scale professional videos (e.g., films, commercials, games) and fine-tune video generation models such as Wan to better follow detailed prompts of up to 400 words, achieving finer control over cinematography including camera motion, angle, lens, focus, point of view, and framing. Our results show that precise specification and human-AI oversight are key to professional-level video understanding and generation. Data and code are available on our project page: https://linzhiqiu.github.io/papers/chai/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套开放数据集、基准和可扩展监督方法CHAI，通过专业视频创作者定义的视觉原语实现精确视频描述，利用人类-AI协作批评机制提升标注质量，并训练出超越Gemini-3.1-Pro的模型，同时将精细描述应用于视频生成模型，实现对摄影机运动、角度等参数的控制。
AI.motivation: 现有视频-语言模型在精确理解视频动态内容（如主体、场景、运动、空间关系和摄影机动态）方面能力不足，缺乏结构化的描述规范和高质量标注数据。
AI.method: 1) 定义结构化规范，包含数百个由专业视频创作者（如电影制作人）定义的视觉原语；2) 提出CHAI框架，由人类专家批评并修正模型生成的预描述，得到改进后的后描述；3) 利用批评数据通过SFT、DPO和推理时扩展训练开源模型。
AI.result: 经过有限专家监督训练出的模型在视频描述任务上超越Gemini-3.1-Pro等闭源模型；将精细描述应用于Wan等视频生成模型后，实现了对摄影机运动、角度、镜头、焦距、视点和构图等参数的有效控制。
AI.conclusion: 精确的结构化规范与人类-AI协同监督是提升专业级视频理解与生成能力的关键。

title: Ramen: Robust Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models with Active Sample Selection
summary: Pretrained vision-language models such as CLIP exhibit strong zero-shot generalization but remain sensitive to distribution shifts. Test-time adaptation adapts models during inference without access to source data or target labels, offering a practical way to handle such shifts. However, existing methods typically assume that test samples come from a single, consistent domain, while in practice, test data often include samples from mixed domains with distinct characteristics. Consequently, their performance degrades under mixed-domain settings. To address this, we present Ramen, a framework for robust test-time adaptation through active sample selection. For each incoming test sample, Ramen retrieves a customized batch of relevant samples from previously seen data based on two criteria: domain consistency, which ensures that adaptation focuses on data from similar domains, and prediction balance, which mitigates adaptation bias caused by skewed predictions. To improve efficiency, Ramen employs an embedding-gradient cache that stores the embeddings and sample-level gradients of past test images. The stored embeddings are used to retrieve relevant samples, and the corresponding gradients are aggregated for model updates, eliminating the need for any additional forward or backward passes. Our theoretical analysis provides insight into why the proposed adaptation mechanism is effective under mixed-domain shifts. Experiments on multiple image corruption and domain-shift benchmarks demonstrate that Ramen achieves strong and consistent performance, offering robust and efficient adaptation in complex mixed-domain scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/baowenxuan/Ramen .

AI.tldr: 提出Ramen框架，通过主动样本选择实现鲁棒的测试时自适应，有效应对混合域分布偏移问题。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时自适应方法假设测试样本来自单一一致域，但实际中测试数据常包含混合域样本，导致性能下降。
AI.method: Ramen为每个测试样本检索定制的相关样本批次，基于域一致性（关注相似域数据）和预测平衡（缓解预测偏差）两个标准；并利用嵌入-梯度缓存存储历史样本的嵌入和梯度，避免额外前向/反向传播。
AI.result: 在多个图像损坏和域偏移基准上，Ramen在混合域场景下实现了强且一致的性能。
AI.conclusion: Ramen通过主动样本选择和高效缓存机制，为混合域分布偏移下的测试时自适应提供了鲁棒且高效的解决方案。

title: Interpretable facial dynamics as behavioral and perceptual traces of deepfakes
comment: Main paper: 19 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. SI Appendix: 11 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables
summary: Deepfake detection research has largely converged on deep learning approaches that, despite strong benchmark performance, offer limited insight into what distinguishes real from manipulated facial behavior. This study presents an interpretable alternative grounded in bio-behavioral features of facial dynamics and evaluates how computational detection strategies relate to human perceptual judgments. We identify core low-dimensional patterns of facial movement, from which temporal features characterizing spatiotemporal structure were derived. Traditional machine learning classifiers trained on these features achieved modest but significant above-chance deepfake classification, driven by higher-order temporal irregularities that were more pronounced in manipulated than real facial dynamics. Notably, detection was substantially more accurate for videos containing emotive expressions than those without. An emotional valence classification analysis further indicated that emotive signals are systematically degraded in deepfakes, explaining the differential impact of emotive dynamics on detection. Furthermore, we provide an additional and often overlooked dimension of explainability by assessing the relationship between model decisions and human perceptual detection. Model and human judgments converged for emotive but diverged for non-emotive videos, and even where outputs aligned, underlying detection strategies differed. These findings demonstrate that face-swapped deepfakes carry a measurable behavioral fingerprint, most salient during emotional expression. Additionally, model-human comparisons suggest that interpretable computational features and human perception may offer complementary rather than redundant routes to detection.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种基于面部生物行为特征的可解释深度伪造检测方法，发现伪造视频在情感表达时存在更高阶的时间不规则性，且模型与人类检测在情感视频上趋于一致但在非情感视频上存在分歧。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测方法多基于深度学习，虽然性能优异但缺乏可解释性，难以揭示真实与伪造面部行为之间的本质区别。
AI.method: 提取面部运动的低维模式及时空结构的时间特征，使用传统机器学习分类器进行检测，并评估模型决策与人类感知判断的关系。
AI.result: 传统分类器达到中等但显著的检测效果；情感表达视频的检测准确率远高于非情感视频；伪造视频中的情感信号存在系统性退化；模型与人类判断在情感视频上一致但在非情感视频上存在分歧。
AI.conclusion: 换脸深度伪造存在可测量的行为指纹，在情感表达时最为显著；可解释的计算特征与人类感知可能提供互补而非冗余的检测路径。

title: Back to Source: Open-Set Continual Test-Time Adaptation via Domain Compensation
summary: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) aims to mitigate distributional shifts between training and test domains during inference time. However, existing TTA methods fall short in the realistic scenario where models face both continually changing domains and the simultaneous emergence of unknown semantic classes, a challenging setting we term Open-set Continual Test-Time Adaptation (OCTTA). The coupling of domain and semantic shifts often collapses the feature space, severely degrading both classification and out-of-distribution detection. To tackle this, we propose DOmain COmpensation (DOCO), a lightweight and effective framework that robustly performs domain adaptation and OOD detection in a synergistic, closed loop. DOCO first performs dynamic, adaptation-conditioned sample splitting to separate likely ID from OOD samples. Then, using only the ID samples, it learns a domain compensation prompt by aligning feature statistics with the source domain, guided by a structural preservation regularizer that prevents semantic distortion. This learned prompt is then propagated to the OOD samples within the same batch, effectively isolating their semantic novelty for more reliable detection. Extensive experiments on multiple challenging benchmarks demonstrate that DOCO outperforms prior CTTA and OSTTA methods, establishing a new state-of-the-art for the demanding OCTTA setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DOCO框架，通过闭环协同进行域自适应和开放集检测，解决开放集持续测试时自适应（OCTTA）中域偏移与语义类别涌现并存的问题，达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有TTA方法无法应对持续变化的域与未知语义类别同时出现的现实场景（OCTTA），域偏移与语义偏移耦合会导致特征空间坍塌，分类和OOD检测性能严重下降。
AI.method: 提出DOCO框架：1）动态自适应条件样本分割，分离ID和OOD样本；2）仅用ID样本学习域补偿提示，通过特征统计对齐源域并加入结构保持正则化防止语义扭曲；3）将学到的提示传播给同批次的OOD样本，隔离语义新颖性以提高检测可靠性。
AI.result: 在多个挑战性基准上的大量实验表明，DOCO优于先前的CTTA和OSTTA方法，在OCTTA设定中达到新的SOTA。
AI.conclusion: DOCO通过轻量级框架有效解决了域适应与OOD检测的协同问题，为OCTTA这一更具挑战性的现实场景提供了有效的解决方案。

title: From Codebooks to VLMs: Evaluating Automated Visual Discourse Analysis for Climate Change on Social Media
summary: Social media platforms have become primary arenas for climate communication, generating millions of images and posts that - if systematically analysed - can reveal which communication strategies mobilise public concern and which fall flat. We aim to facilitate such research by analysing how computer vision methods can be used for social media discourse analysis. This analysis includes application-based taxonomy design, model selection, prompt engineering, and validation. We benchmark six promptable vision-language models and 15 zero-shot CLIP-like models on two datasets from X (formerly Twitter) - a 1,038-image expert-annotated set and a larger corpus of over 1.2 million images, with 50,000 labels manually validated - spanning five annotation dimensions: animal content, climate change consequences, climate action, image setting, and image type. Among the models benchmarked, Gemini-3.1-flash-lite outperforms all others across all super-categories and both datasets, while the gap to open-weight models of moderate size remains relatively small. Beyond instance-level metrics, we advocate for distributional evaluation: VLM predictions can reliably recover population level trends even when per-image accuracy is moderate, making them a viable starting point for discourse analysis at scale. We find that chain-of-thought reasoning reduces rather than improves performance, and that annotation dimension specific prompt design improves performance. We release tweet IDs and labels along with our code at https://github.com/KathPra/Codebooks2VLMs.git.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了计算机视觉方法（特别是视觉语言模型）在社交媒体气候传播话语分析中的应用，通过两个X平台数据集（含人工标注）对多种模型进行基准测试，发现Gemini-3.1-flash-lite表现最优，链式思维推理反而降低性能，分布级评估比实例级更可靠。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体上大量气候相关内容未被系统分析，需要自动化的计算机视觉方法来揭示哪些传播策略能有效激发公众关注，从而推动气候传播研究。
AI.method: 设计应用导向的分类体系，选择视觉语言模型并进行提示工程和验证。在5个标注维度（动物内容、气候后果、气候行动、图像场景、图像类型）上，对6个可提示视觉语言模型和15个零样本CLIP类模型进行基准测试，使用两个X平台数据集（1,038张专家标注图像和120万+图像的大语料库）。采用链式思维推理和维度特定提示设计等方法。
AI.result: Gemini-3.1-flash-lite在所有超类别和两个数据集上均超越其他模型；链式思维推理降低了性能；维度特定的提示设计能提升效果；分布级评估（而非实例级）能可靠恢复总体趋势。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型可作为大规模气候话语分析的可行起点，分布级评估更具实用价值，提示设计应针对特定标注维度优化，而非使用通用推理策略。

title: TEMA: Anchor the Image, Follow the Text for Multi-Modification Composed Image Retrieval
summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) is an important image retrieval paradigm that enables users to retrieve a target image using a multimodal query that consists of a reference image and modification text. Although research on CIR has made significant progress, prevailing setups still rely simple modification texts that typically cover only a limited range of salient changes, which induces two limitations highly relevant to practical applications, namely Insufficient Entity Coverage and Clause-Entity Misalignment. In order to address these issues and bring CIR closer to real-world use, we construct two instruction-rich multi-modification datasets, M-FashionIQ and M-CIRR. In addition, we propose TEMA, the Text-oriented Entity Mapping Architecture, which is the first CIR framework designed for multi-modification while also accommodating simple modifications. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate that TEMA's superiority in both original and multi-modification scenarios, while maintaining an optimal balance between retrieval accuracy and computational efficiency. Our codes and constructed multi-modification dataset (M-FashionIQ and M-CIRR) are available at https://github.com/lee-zixu/ACL26-TEMA/.

AI.tldr: 本文针对组合图像检索（CIR）中现有方法依赖简单修改文本、导致实体覆盖不足和从句-实体不对齐的问题，构建了两个多修改数据集M-FashionIQ和M-CIRR，并提出首个支持多修改的CIR框架TEMA，在精度与效率间取得最优平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有CIR方法依赖简单修改文本，存在两个实际问题：实体覆盖不足（仅覆盖部分显著变化）和从句-实体不对齐（修改文本与图像实体对应关系混乱），亟需将CIR推向更贴近真实应用的场景。
AI.method: 1）构建两个多修改指令数据集M-FashionIQ和M-CIRR；2）提出TEMA（Text-oriented Entity Mapping Architecture），首个面向多修改场景的CIR框架，同时兼容简单修改。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，TEMA在原始场景和多修改场景下均具有优越性，并在检索精度与计算效率之间取得了最佳平衡。
AI.conclusion: TEMA有效解决了现有CIR在复杂多修改场景下的不足，推动了CIR向真实应用迈进，且代码与数据集已开源。

title: Multiscale Super Resolution without Image Priors
summary: We address the ambiguities in the super-resolution problem under translation. We demonstrate that combinations of low-resolution images at different scales can be used to make the super-resolution problem well posed. Such differences in scale can be achieved using sensors with different pixel sizes (as demonstrated here) or by varying the effective pixel size through changes in optical magnification (e.g., using a zoom lens). We show that images acquired with pairwise coprime pixel sizes lead to a system with a stable inverse, and furthermore, that super-resolution images can be reconstructed efficiently using Fourier domain techniques or iterative least squares methods. Our mathematical analysis provides an expression for the expected error of the least squares reconstruction for large signals assuming i.i.d. noise that elucidates the noise-resolution tradeoff. These results are validated through both one- and two-dimensional experiments that leverage charge-coupled device (CCD) hardware binning to explore reconstructions over a large range of effective pixel sizes. Finally, two-dimensional reconstructions for a series of targets are used to demonstrate the advantages of multiscale super-resolution, and implications of these results for common imaging systems are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用具有互质像素尺寸的多尺度低分辨率图像，将超分辨率问题转化为适定问题，并通过傅里叶域技术或迭代最小二乘法高效重建高分辨率图像，同时给出了噪声-分辨率权衡的数学误差表达式，实验验证了该方法在CCD硬件下的有效性。
AI.motivation: 超分辨率问题在平移变换下存在歧义性，传统方法难以稳定求解。本文旨在通过多尺度低分辨率图像组合来消除这种歧义，使问题变得适定。
AI.method: 使用像素尺寸互质的传感器获取多尺度低分辨率图像，构建具有稳定逆的系统；采用傅里叶域技术或迭代最小二乘法进行超分辨率重建；通过数学分析推导了假设独立同分布噪声下最小二乘重建的期望误差表达式。
AI.result: 互质像素尺寸的多尺度图像组合能够使超分辨率问题适定且逆稳定；在二维CCD硬件实验中验证了该方法的有效性；实验展示了多尺度超分辨率相较于传统方法的优势。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度超分辨率方法能够有效解决超分辨率中的歧义问题，在不同尺度和噪声水平下均能实现稳定重建，对实际成像系统具有重要指导意义。

title: Grounding Video Reasoning in Physical Signals
comment: Benchmark for Grounding Video Reasoning in Physical Signals
summary: Physical video understanding requires more than naming an event correctly. A model can answer a question about pouring, sliding, or collision from textual regularities while still failing to localize the event in time or space. We introduce a grounded benchmark for physical video understanding that extends the what--when--where evaluation structure of V-STaR to four video sources, six physics domains, three prompt families (physics, vstar_like, and neutral_rstr), and four input conditions (original, shuffled, ablated, and frame-masked). The benchmark contains 1,560 base video clips from SSV2, YouCook2, HoloAssist, and Roundabout-TAU. Each clip is first converted into a shared grounded event record, and the three query families are derived from that record. Temporal and spatial targets are shared across prompt families, while the non-physics families use deterministic family-appropriate semantic a_what targets derived from the same record. Across models and prompt families, physics remains the strongest regime overall, vstar_like is the clearest non-physics semantic comparison, and neutral_rstr behaves as a harder templated control. Prompt-family robustness is selective rather than universal, perturbation gains cluster in weak original cases, and spatial grounding is the weakest across settings.
